description: This is a unit test class for the ImmutablePropertyFilter class in the org.eclipse.ditto.model.thingsearch package. It contains tests to verify immutability, equality, constructor null checks, getter methods, and string representations related to different filter types.

classes.name: ImmutablePropertyFilterTest
classes.description: Unit test class for ImmutablePropertyFilter, testing immutability, equality, null handling, getters, collection immutability, value checks, and string representations.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Verifies that ImmutablePropertyFilter and related argument types are immutable.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Verifies the equals and hashCode contract for ImmutablePropertyFilter.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullType
methods.description: Ensures creating ImmutablePropertyFilter with null type throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullPropertyPath
methods.description: Ensures creating ImmutablePropertyFilter with null property path throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullValues
methods.description: Ensures creating ImmutablePropertyFilter with null values throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: getTypeReturnsExpected
methods.description: Checks that getType returns the correct filter type.

methods.name: getPathReturnsExpected
methods.description: Checks that getPath returns the correct property path.

methods.name: getValuesReturnsUnmodifiableCollection
methods.description: Verifies that getValues returns an unmodifiable collection.

methods.name: getValuesReturnsExpected
methods.description: Checks that getValues returns the correct values for an IN filter.

methods.name: toStringOfInTypeFilterReturnsExpectedRepresentation
methods.description: Verifies string representation of an IN type filter.

methods.name: toStringOfExistsTypeFilterReturnsExpectedRepresentation
methods.description: Verifies string representation of an EXISTS type filter.
